
```{r tied_model, eval = FALSE}

###############################################################################
# Section 4.1: Deprivation in Dar es Salaam — Bradley-Terry with Ties
###############################################################################

# Inspect comparison data
head(darEsSalaam$comparisons)

# Construct prior covariance matrix
prior.var <- expm::expm(darEsSalaam$adjacencyMatrix)
prior.var <- diag(diag(prior.var)^-0.5) %*%
  prior.var %*%
  diag(diag(prior.var)^-0.5)

# Fit tied BT model
darTiedModel <- BBTm.ties(
  outcome = darEsSalaam$comparisons$outcome,
  item1 = darEsSalaam$comparisons$subward1,
  item2 = darEsSalaam$comparisons$subward2,
  item.prior.var = prior.var,
  hyperparameter = TRUE,
  rw.sd = 0.005,
  n.iter = 5000,
  burn.in = 100
)

# Trace plot and histogram for threshold parameter theta
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(
  parameter(darTiedModel, "theta"),
  type = 'l',
  xlab = "Iteration",
  ylab = expression(theta)
)
hist(
  parameter(darTiedModel, "theta"),
  main = "",
  xlab = expression(theta),
  freq = FALSE
)

# Posterior mean and 95% credible interval for theta
mean(parameter(darTiedModel, "theta"))
quantile(parameter(darTiedModel, "theta"), c(0.025, 0.975))
```
